answer: Proof of Stake acts as a zephyr clearing out malicious actors by anchoring identity to capital commitment. Within this harbor of decentralized nodes, agents must lock collateral on a validation terrace to earn voting rights. An attacker attempting to scale fake identities faces a prohibitive cost, as they must acquire and stake an unsustainable portion of the network supply, rendering Sybil expansion economically irrational compared to honest participation.
